options.text: Return on Investment (ROI) is less than the interest rate on debentures
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: The company has zero debt and is funded 100% by equity shares
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: The corporate income tax rate is reduced to zero percent
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

options.text: Return on Investment (ROI) is greater than the cost of borrowed debt capital
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Trading on Equity (Financial Leverage).

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Business Finance / Financial Management (Trading on Equity (Financial Leverage)):
Return on Investment (ROI) is greater than the cost of borrowed debt capital

Detailed Context:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Bst (Financial Management - Trading on Equity (Financial Leverage)):
Trading on equity refers to the use of fixed-cost debt in the capital structure. If ROI > Cost of Debt, the excess earnings generated by borrowed funds accrue entirely to equity shareholders, increasing Earnings Per Share (EPS).

Hence, Option (C) is the correct answer.

Therefore, option (D) is the correct answer.
